verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs say it calculates and files taxes automatically and handles all associated federal, state, and local filings. A community report confirms Gusto produces W-2s and W-2c corrections, though that user saw an incorrect W-2c that double-reported to the IRS. There is no explicit documentation of year-end W-2/1099 generation or of distributing the forms to workers. Missing for 10: documented W-2 generation workflow, 1099-NEC generation for contractors, automatic distribution to employees and contractors, and independent corroboration of reliable year-end form accuracy.
